defects: The fqih's right hand and sleeve wiping his brow obscure almost his entire face.
Mohammed's (center boy) white djellaba hem bulges into two stiff lumps over his crossed legs on the floor mat.
tiles.fix: Angle the fqih's wiping hand slightly higher toward his forehead so his eyes remain visible, and smooth the cloth deformation on Mohammed's seated hem.

defects: The boy on the right (blue tunic) holds his slate horizontally with an awkwardly bent wrist that breaks the fanning gesture.
tiles.fix: Adjust the right boy's wrist rotation so the slate angles naturally toward his face.

defects: The boy entering through the doorway behind the fqih is largely occluded by the fqih's left shoulder, and his forearms clip into the slate held flat to his chest.
tiles.fix: Stagger the boy half a step back and to camera right in the doorway so he reads clearly, and pull the slate slightly forward outside his forearms.

defects: Both boys' slates clip straight through their forearms and sleeves: the middle boy's brown slate blends into his brown tunic while his hands poke out above it at his collarbones, and Mohammed's slate slices through both of his white sleeves.
The fqih stands stiffly on the left staring blankly off-screen right instead of leading the boys in.
tiles.fix: Pull both slates forward in front of the boys' chests with their hands gripping the outer edges cleanly outside the slate mesh, and turn the fqih slightly toward the boys.

defects: Staging misses the beat intent: the railed tomb sits against the far-left wall while the two young women walk in the open center/right of the room instead of circling the tomb (so the far half of the lap is never hidden behind it).
The center woman in green faces the camera with her left hand glued stiffly to her thigh.
tiles.fix: Path the women directly around the railed tomb on the left so they clearly circle the tomb itself.

defects: The three women do not form a coherent circuit around the tomb on the left: the woman in dark green on the right walks toward the right wall facing away from the tomb, while the center woman in pink glides across the open floor.
tiles.fix: Place all three women along a single circular path around the tomb, oriented in the same walking direction.

defects: Mohammed's eyes are wide open instead of closed for a deep breath.
The wooden slate tucked under Mohammed's left arm clips straight through his left sleeve and forearm, leaving only his fingertips poking out at the bottom.
tiles.fix: Close Mohammed's eyelids, add a subtle chest-inhale pose, and offset the slate outside his left sleeve with his hand cleanly wrapping its bottom edge.

defects: The M crop cuts off the top of Mohammed's head at the upper frame edge.
Mohammed's eyes remain half-open looking down instead of closed, and the slate visibly intersects his left sleeve and forearm in close-up.
tiles.fix: Tilt the crop up slightly to leave headroom above Mohammed's skull, close his eyes fully, and resolve the slate-through-sleeve clipping on his left arm.

defects: The M crop leaves the top half of a boy's head sticking into the bottom-left corner cut off at the eyes, while the top of the fqih's hood grazes the upper frame edge.
tiles.fix: Shift the crop slightly right and up to exclude the cut-off boy's head in the bottom-left corner while preserving headroom for the fqih.

defects: Neither boy on the left reaches the fountain basin on the far-left wall: the blue-tunic boy bends with his hands in mid-air well below the basin, and Mohammed bends over empty carpet behind him with his hands held in mid-air.
Both boys are scaled far too small relative to the fqih and the nearby wooden stand.
tiles.fix: Scale the two boys up to match the room perspective and move them directly up to the tiled fountain basin so their hands reach the water spout.

defects: The rightmost boy in the prayer row (white djellaba and skullcap) turns his head left toward the boy next to him instead of facing forward in qiyam, and the right half of the row stands offset to the side of the fqih.
tiles.fix: Center the boys' prayer row behind the fqih and orient the rightmost boy's head straight ahead toward the qibla wall.

defects: The ruku poses read as awkward forward stumbles rather than prayer bows, with knees bent and torsos pitched at 45 degrees with arms hanging instead of hinged backs and hands on knees.
The fqih shrinks noticeably compared to his standing scale in 44.1, and the second boy from right appears to slide forward on his feet.
tiles.fix: Pose the fqih and boys in proper ruku with upright legs, hinged backs, and hands resting on knees, and restore the fqih's consistent scale relative to the boys.

worst_problem: In s04 39.4 the two boys performing ablutions are scaled too small and bend over empty floor with their hands in mid-air instead of reaching the fountain basin, while in s04 13.7, 29.4 and 31.6 the boys' wooden slates clip straight through their forearms and sleeves.
